summary: Full independent validation of the new Call Center feature (/api/voice/console + CallConsole/CallReview/CallHistory). Backend: 34 pytest tests across 3 new suites — all PASS (config creation + authority freeze + disclosure script, phone-number validation, org isolation 404, explicit-approval TEST simulation producing transcript+analysis, double-approve 400, analyze with/without transcript, session/history shape, outcome gate with 4 decisions + invalid 400, LIVE-mode honest failure, webhook token 401s, webhook happy-path with correct token, authority immutability via webhook, transcript push, idempotent status-callback, offer mirror flagging). Additionally proved the authority clamp directly via ai_service.analyze_call with a transcript at INR 61 vs max 56 -> within_authority=false, requires_human_approval=true, unit price term labelled REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL. Frontend: complete E2E Playwright run (login -> mission -> exotel-call-{vendorId} -> Call Test Console -> review panel -> Start AI Test Call -> Call Review Center -> Approve next step -> mission Call History -> reopen review) all PASS. No 500s, no console errors, no broken selectors. Nothing auto-created a purchase/order; mission stayed at REQUIREMENT_REVIEW.

minor.issue: Accepts a terminal status for a call that was never approved/placed. A CONFIGURED (approved=false, call_sid=null) session was transitioned to status='completed' with duration=42 by a single token-authenticated webhook. Suggest rejecting/ignoring callbacks for sessions where approved is false or call_sid is null so an unapproved call can never appear as a completed call.
Same class of issue — sets status='connected' and RECORDING_ACTIVE on an unapproved CONFIGURED session. Should require approved=true.
No validation that target_price <= max_authorized_price (or that either is > 0). A config with target 90 / max 50 is accepted and frozen as authority. Recommend a 400 on inverted/negative authority.

Outcome can be recorded on a CONFIGURED call that has no transcript/analysis, and can be overwritten repeatedly (APPROVE_NEXT then REJECT both accepted, last write wins, no decision history array). Consider requiring a terminal status and appending to an outcome_history.

issues: analysis.within_authority / requires_human_approval are never rendered. In the verified run the final discussed price was INR 64.5 against a max authorized of INR 56 (offer stored as OUT_OF_AUTHORITY), yet the summary card only showed neutral/positive badges — a green-toned '17.31% improvement' and 'FINAL DISCUSSED INR 64.5'. Add an explicit red 'EXCEEDS MAX AUTHORIZED / REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL' banner and suppress/recolour the improvement badge when within_authority is false. This is the most user-visible trust gap in the feature.

The 4 approval-gate buttons record a decision on first click with no confirm step, and once set the gate collapses to a read-only line with no way to change/see history even though the API allows overwriting.

within_authority / OUT_OF_AUTHORITY is not surfaced anywhere in the frontend (grep found zero references), so the voice-call offer at INR 64.5 (> max 56) appears as an ordinary offer. The offer is also simulation=true but the UI does not label it as simulated in the offers list.

During a TEST call the page stays on the dimmed approval panel for ~40s with only a small spinner in the button; no progress/step indicator ('connecting -> negotiating -> analysing'). Users may think it hung.

action_items: CallReview.js: render analysis.within_authority === false / requires_human_approval as a prominent warning banner and stop showing a positive 'improvement' badge for an above-max price.

Surface within_authority/OUT_OF_AUTHORITY and simulation flags on the mission offers list; consider excluding or hard-flagging OUT_OF_AUTHORITY offers in POST /api/missions/{id}/compare (it currently picks min landed cost across ALL offers, so a voice-call price above the authorized max can be recommended).
Guard /status-callback and /voice-start so they only mutate sessions where approved is true (and ideally call_sid matches).
Validate authority in POST /config (target_price <= max_authorized_price, non-negative).
Optional: add progress states to the Call Test Console during the ~40s simulation.
critical_code_review_comments: compare() in server.py aggregates every offer for a mission with no authority filter; _persist_offer_from_analysis now injects SIMULATED voice-call prices into that same collection. A simulated, out-of-authority price is therefore eligible to be recommended for approval. Filter by within_authority (and simulation) or clearly rank it last.

Authority freezing itself is implemented correctly: _authority_from_objective is computed server-side at config time, webhooks only read it, and a webhook payload attempting max_authorized_price=99999 did not change the stored authority (verified).
LIVE mode is honest: approve returned status='failed' (Exotel rejected the call) with no transcript, no analysis and no offer — no fake success.

status_callback's idempotency key is a boolean terminal_recorded flag rather than the CallSid, so a legitimate later callback for a *retried* call on the same session_ref would be dropped as 'duplicate'. Minor, but keying on CallSid would be safer.
call_center.py is 585 lines — acceptable now, but the simulation + offer-mirror helpers would be better in their own module before it grows further.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 pytest, plus 1/1 direct analyze_call clamp test)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested E2E flow steps passed

seed_data_creation: Reused existing mission b983bb2f74bd44f29685978e16251d93 / vendor 3a7c1a1bc7fd486599d696c7674c2177. Created several voice_calls documents (TEST_ prefixed suppliers/instructions) including one completed simulated call, one LIVE failed call, and one webhook fixture call. One voice_call offer (INR 64.5, OUT_OF_AUTHORITY) exists on that mission from the simulated call. No missions/vendors/users created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suites: tests/test_call_center.py (27 tests, ~65s — the simulation fixture makes several LLM calls, keep timeouts >=240s), tests/test_call_webhooks.py (needs EXOTEL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN from backend/.env), tests/test_call_offer_mirror.py, tests/test_call_authority_clamp.py (direct ai_service call, loads /app/backend/.env). All 34 pass as of this iteration. Every review-request bullet was covered and passed; the only open items are the UI not surfacing within_authority/requires_human_approval, compare() not filtering OUT_OF_AUTHORITY offers, and webhooks being able to advance an unapproved session. Do NOT re-run LIVE mode more than once (fails at Exotel by design).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the Call Center feature itself. The authority-above-max case is detected correctly end-to-end (analysis.within_authority=false, requires_human_approval=true, term labelled REQUIRES_HUMAN_APPROVAL, offer stored as OUT_OF_AUTHORITY) — the gap is purely presentational: CallReview.js never reads those two fields, so a price INR 8.5/unit above the authorized maximum is displayed alongside a positive '17.31% improvement' badge, and the downstream compare endpoint does not filter such offers.
